title: Case 007: Pickup deadline is too short for the recipient

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The parcel is already at a pickup counter. A short extension is allowed by that operator; only the operator may approve it.
initial_request: My work trip ends on 2026-02-10. Could you keep DL-007 for me until 2026-02-11? I do not want it returned.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request an extension from the pickup-point operator within its stated policy.

outcome: The operator confirms the new collection deadline and the recipient is notified.
boundaries: An extension does not prove the customer collected the parcel.

events.body: DL-007 is held until 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC. Our local policy allows a single two-day extension if requested before expiry and stock capacity permits. We currently have capacity.
My work trip ends on 2026-02-10. Could you keep DL-007 for me until 2026-02-11? I do not want it returned.
Please approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, at Ciro’s request. Let us know once the return timer has been updated.
Extension accepted. The collection deadline is now 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC and the return timer uses that date. This is the one permitted extension.
The counter has confirmed your new deadline: 2026-02-11 at 18:00 UTC. Your parcel is still awaiting collection.
